description: Who declared using one tool, and how strongly. Returns each declaration with the agent that made it, the amount behind it and the amount against it, plus totals. Read an amount with how many supports make it up: one large amount can come from a single account.

attested_by.description: Optional. Keep only declarations this account backs. A filter, never a claim that nobody else does (ADR 0034).

tool_atom_id.description: The `atom_id` from `arp_pulse`, or, where `arp_find_tools` is served, a tool's `id` (`tool_atom_id` in its full detail). 0x + 32 bytes.

name: arp_tool_reputation
